title: Meta-review dashboard for one submission

provenance.origin: Written for the AstaUI prototype; not a real participant's work.

notes: The submission and its four reviews are invented. The tagged points were pulled from the reviews when they were pasted in and are embedded in the file; points the associate chair tags by hand, the layout choice, the recommendation and the draft are kept in localStorage. The weighted mean uses each reviewer's self-rated expertise (1 to 4) as the weight.
